name: Classic Buzz
description: Even, very short length with a clean outline and minimal daily styling.

robot_parameters.notes: Uniform short proposal; confirm hairline and guard preference with a professional.

name: Tapered Crew Cut
description: A tidy short top with gradually shorter sides and back.

robot_parameters.notes: Leave slightly more length at the front; descriptive proposal only.

name: Textured Crop
description: Short, broken-up texture on top with a compact silhouette.

robot_parameters.notes: Texturizing and fringe finish require a stylist; no motion plan is implied.

name: Classic Side Part
description: Medium-short top shaped to one side with conservative tapering.

robot_parameters.notes: Part direction and cowlicks must be assessed in person.

name: Soft Quiff
description: Extra front height with a softer, touchable finish.

robot_parameters.notes: Preserve 90 mm near the front for lift; styling product usually required.

name: Low Pompadour
description: Swept-back volume without the extreme height of a traditional pomp.

robot_parameters.notes: Volume and graduation are stylist decisions; descriptive proposal only.

name: French Crop
description: A compact top and short forward fringe, often paired with a low fade.

robot_parameters.notes: Fringe line must be confirmed visually before any physical service.

name: Curtain Fringe
description: A longer center-parted fringe that frames the forehead and cheeks.

robot_parameters.notes: Preserve face-framing length; actual part depends on growth pattern.

name: Caesar Cut
description: Short, even layering with a small forward fringe.

robot_parameters.notes: Maintain a soft, short fringe; final outline is a stylist choice.

name: Slick Back Taper
description: Longer top directed backward with a neat tapered perimeter.

robot_parameters.notes: Direction and holding product depend on density and growth pattern.

name: Rounded Afro Taper
description: Natural coily volume shaped softly with a clean perimeter taper.

robot_parameters.notes: Shrinkage, curl pattern, and desired shape require in-person assessment.

name: Short Curl Taper
description: Defined short curls on top with gently reduced sides.

robot_parameters.notes: Lengths refer to unstretched planning estimates; shrinkage varies.

name: Long Soft Layers
description: Long shape with subtle movement and face-framing layers.

robot_parameters.notes: Layer elevation and perimeter shape are intentionally unspecified for a stylist.

name: Textured Pixie
description: A short layered shape with flexible texture around the crown and fringe.

robot_parameters.notes: Layering and fringe direction require a stylist's judgment.

name: Disconnected Undercut
description: Long top contrasted with very short sides for a bold silhouette.

robot_parameters.notes: Disconnection line and blend decision must be confirmed by a professional.
